diagnostic.question: In a new patient situation (variant 1), an older person has new unsteadiness after a medication change; what is the safe next step?
diagnostic.generated_answer:
A) Administer a dose of the old medication to correct the problem B) Have the patient take the new medication C) Have the patient take the old medication D) Have the patient take both medications simultaneously
The answer is B) Have the patient take the new medication.
